name: Seated Roll Back with Straps

load.note: The spring helps you up, so lighter is harder.

summary: Sitting facing the straps with knees bent and a loop in each hand, curl the tail under and roll back halfway with the straps taking some of the weight, then curl up.
steps: Sit facing the straps, knees bent, feet on the headrest or the carriage; short loops in the hands, arms long.
Breathe out to tuck the tail and roll back until the lower back is close to the carriage.
Breathe out to curl forward and stack up tall.

layers.title: Hold and curl the arms
layers.text: Stay back and add biceps curls.

layers.title: Add a twist
layers.text: Turn the ribs to one side at the back.

layers.title: Single arm row
layers.text: Row one arm as you turn.

cues:
Start from the pelvis, not the chest.
Arms stay long — don't pull yourself up with them.
Shoulders stay over the ribs.
